specs.title: three allowlisted samples, source highlight, search, export and private diagnostic
missing isolation is actionable and comparison cannot start
engine bundle download failure leaves a reload screen
failed engine worker initialization can be retried
twenty cancellation cycles leave no workers and allow a complete subsequent result
a cancel click that lands after the task finished changes nothing
moved text jumps both sides; identity remains with displayed PDF after next selection
corrupt input fails and password is handled locally
non-BMP scalar maps to its visible rotated glyph with CropBox and UserUnit
added text navigates the missing side to reference context only when sync is enabled
removed text navigates the missing side to reference context only when sync is enabled
different page counts do not force equal physical page numbers
an unextractable counterpart uses a labelled page reference, never a claimed text match
a paired paragraph navigates both direct sources even when only one side has edited characters
count-only increases stay out of change cards and preserve all sources
count-only decreases stay out of change cards and preserve all sources
a real page-number text change remains a main card and locates the edited digits
optional quantity sources remain visible on a narrow window after explicit navigation
unchanged text with an actual move remains a main review item
changed repeated header remains a red-green main comparison with accessible occurrences
F1 two changed deductibles retain visible sections and both real source rows
F2 damaged body produces explicit partial or failed state and clean/mixed controls remain useful
F5 visible image gap regions respect nested Form matrices and restored state
F7 versioned resources escape old immutable cache and fixed paths revalidate
P1 real PDF amount, search, source quads and JSON export
P1 identical, ligature and scan status
cancel stops workers, old results cannot replace next task; no document upload
repeated occurrences and uncovered image regions are navigable
twenty complete tasks replace previous resources without refreshing the tab
manual swap updates both file controls and comparison direction
all 32 pairs: no failure with browser fine location, only registered coverage gaps left unevaluated

specs.title: wheel crosses page boundaries in either direction, panes remain independent when sync is off
synchronized wheel scrolling follows existing text alignment across pages; buttons still work
a page shorter than the viewport still reaches the final page; rapid scrolling keeps the latest view
every on-screen page renders when the complete document fits without scrolling
height-only resizing loads newly visible pages and retains visible predecessors at the bottom
